nom: MAC Hyper Real Serumizer Eye Treatment

avis.texte: The MAC Serumizer is designed as a lightweight hydrating serum that doubles as a makeup prep step, helping foundation sit smoother and last longer. It sits in that "skincare meets makeup primer" category, which MAC does fairly well across its Prep + Prime range.
Its a good eye cream primer for concealer for mature and dry skin.

I wanted to try the hyper real line and step into using an eye crème being that I'm 40. After consistent use my under eye was brighter and I looked more awake and not tired after work school and just life!

So glad I gave this a try! My one makeup that I can't Leave the house without is concealer. I've tried lots of different under eye brightening creams, but this is far superior to any other. Now, I find, I don't even need concealer to leave the house.

I wanted to like this but it was harsh under my eyes and left me with a severe reaction that I am still recovering from and have struggled to cover with makeup. I love all the other skin products so I was very disappointed that this did not work for me.
I'm been loving this eye serum. It never disappoints. Whenever my eyes need a little pick me up this is what I grab. It helps keep them super hydrated and makes my make up look flawless.

I love this eye treatment! I've been using it consistently and can genuinely see a noticeable decrease in my dark circles — they look brighter and less tired overall. It's wild how much of a difference it's made; I've had to reach for less color corrector under my eyes because the darkness is already softened. The texture feels nice on my skin and smooths everything out before makeup. Highly recommend if you're trying to level up your undereye game! 💛

I didn't expect an eye product to make this big of a difference, but this one did. The texture is light, it sinks in fast, and my under eyes look smoother and more awake within minutes. After a few weeks, I noticed less dryness and my concealer sits better. It feels like one of the few products that actually does what it claims. I'm already planning to buy it again because it has become part of my daily routine without question.

I tried a sample of this by coincidence as I had originally gone shopping looking for a new foundation. I left the store not only with a new foundation, but also with samples from almost the entire Hyper Real line. The lady that was working the makeup counter recommended this for my dry skin and WOW - I am so happy to have asked her for help! I have tried several moisturizers in the past and never found one I loved.. until now. I just purchased the serumizer, serumizer eye, AND the moisturizer from this collection. It leaves my skin feeling weightless, no oily residue, and just a hint of splendid fragrance. LOVE IT!

This product is fantastic! It works as soon as you put it on you can see the difference whether you have puffy eyes or just want a little bit of brightness. The more I use it the more I see it working and highly recommend!
I use this product to soften fine lines around my eyes, and it works very well.

avis.titre: The Hyper Real Line is amazing!
avis.texte: I've been trying out the eye serum for over a month, and I've noticed a difference. They are much more hydrated underneath, and when I apply my concealer it goes on smoothly and looks fresh. I also notice I have darkness under my eyes, lack of sleep more likely, has since looked brighter ever since I added it to my routine. I have been consistent with the line and my results show with how much smooth and youthful my skin is feeling. Plus I also enjoy the scent from the line, because it's not heavily fragrance.

in store it seemed fine when applied by the makeup consultant. When I left the store, was heading home it was tingling under my eye makeup and tigthening- not sure that its suppose to do that. Again, loved the cooling affect when 1st applied but sheer redness and dryness quickly surfaced and caused much irritation. Sadly I had to return it.
I used a sample and instantly loved this. It hydrated my under eyes and feels nice . The liquid concealer doesn't crease when I use this cream now. Big win
I was waiting for a sale to purchase and I am satisfied with this product. It provides nice moisture and works as a nice base to protect the sensitive skin under my eyes.

LOVE IT! Let me just say that I am absolutely in LOVE with the entire Hyper Real skincare line with MAC Cosmetics. I was already using the Hyper Real Serumizer and Skin Canvas and the results were AMAZING! MAC sent me the Serumizer Eye to test out and I've since purchased 2 additional bottles. I'm hoping they never get rid of this skincare line. It is truly EVERYTHING! Skin Type: Combo, leaning more towards oily in T-zone area
Sorry to say I don't see any change by using this product. I love MAC, but I won't be purchasing this again.
This product is great. I don't have much pigment around my eyes, but do have lots of dryness. This really keeps my under eyes hydrated and sits nicely under make up.

avis.titre: Lose 20% of serum to the bottle
avis.texte: Very disappointed that the bottle design means there is no way to get all of the serum out. I'd say there's at least 20% left that won't come out with the pump and will be difficult to get to due to the size and material of the bottle. Also didn't see much in terms of improvement of my dark undereye circles (used it 2x a day as recommended). Definitely not worth the price overall. Love the rest of the Hyper Real line, so very disappointed in the Eye Serum.

I really enjoyed using this product in my skincare routine. I used the eye serum on bare skin and with makeup. I was so pleased with how it brighten up my under eye area. This product also works so amazingly under makeup. I am very happy with the Hyper Real Serumizer™ Skin Balancing Hydration Serum. received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I've been using the MAC Hyper Real Serumizer Eye for a little while now and I'm really impressed! It has a smooth, lightweight texture that feels really refreshing when I apply it. I've noticed my under eye area looks brighter and more hydrated, and it definitely helps with puffiness. The formula absorbs quickly, so it doesn't feel heavy or greasy. Plus, a little goes a long way, so it lasts longer than I expected. Overall it's been a great addition to my skincare routine, and I can see the difference in how my eyes look, definitely worth trying if you're looking for something to help with hydration and brightening!

I have been using it for several weeks. I like the texture, and it feels like a gel cream. It's very lightweight and fast absorbing. It reduces my dark circles after a week. My dark circles look less noticeable, and it goes well under my makeup. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I love this brightening eye serum. It comes in a nice pump bottle and is easy for quick on the go use or travel. The serum is lightweight and goes on so smoothly. My skin feels nice and smooth. It contains Niacinamide to help brighten. It also has vitamin C and Japanese Peony extract to help tighten skin and make it look more moisturized and refreshed. I love MAC products and this one is definitely going in my daily routine. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

The eye cream serum comes out clear and I only used it in the morning. I didn't really see a difference, but it did hydrate my eyebags. The pump dispenses enough. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I like how effective this MAC Hyper Real Serumizer Eye 360 Bright Eye Treatment is in hiding the signs of aging and fatigue. Its lightweight fast absorbing texture has improved the appearance of my dark circles, making the under eye area less puffy and more smooth. I have also noticed how my concealer doesn't crease as it did before. To use, I gently apply the product underneath the eye area twice a day. One pump is enough for each eye. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

The MAC Serumizer Eye is wonderful. It brightens the under eye area & hydrates as well. It could definitely be worn alone or under makeup. I love how fresh and awakened my under eyes are after using it. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes. And I loved it! Feels luxurious on my skin. I use it at night and wake up feeling like my skin looks younger and more hydrated around my eyes.

I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes. I love the easy to use one finger pump aspect of this product first of all . It has a nice creamy hydrating and almost cooling like feel to it when applying. Instantly I notice my eyes brighter and more awake looking . Maybe its in my head but i almost feel like the creases around my eyes kinda of stand out more after applying though. Otherwise recommend and look forward to continuous use.

First of all, I love the product and the bottle it's in. It looks and feels like luxury. Secondly, the actual product was used as directed on the box. I used this product morning and evening after cleaning my face and did one eye at a time. The serum is lightweight and has a scent, but it's not overbearing. I love the way the serum felt massaging it into my under eye area in 360° motion. I never felt like my under eyes were greasy or heavy feeling with the product. I did feel more hydrated and awake and my skin felt soft and amazing and looked better after several uses. I recommend this product to everyone that needs a little under eye self care. I'm grateful for this product because I definitely deal with dark circles and puffiness and this product has helped a lot. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

The very first time I tried this serum I noticed a change in the overall look of my dark circles, it reduced the inflamation and the appearance of tired eyes. Only a tiny amount works just fine! I've tried this kind of serums from other brands and this one is so much better.

I absolutely love this eye cream! The texture is very luxurious and feels so smooth on my skin. I have notieced my dark circles diminishing since using this product.The packaging is very sturdy and dispenses the perfect amount of cream! I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I absolutely love this eye cream! The texture is very luxurious and feels so smooth on my skin. I have noticed my dark circles diminishing since using this product. The packaging is very sturdy and dispenses the perfect amount of cream!
It works wonders on my moisturizing my skin under the eyes, but I haven't seen my it brighten my bags. Using for about 2 weeks now.

I absolutely love this product. I received it as a tester and fell in love with it. Not only did it help with my dark spots but I was able to see a difference in no time. I recommend this product to everyone.

As someone with dark circles and many creases under my eyes, I'm always looking for products to moisturize and brighten up my undereye area. I used this product with my morning skincare routine and it sit well on my face not drying out too quickly. I recommend this product to anyone looking to brighten up their under eye areas. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.
This is incredible. I think it's my new favorite eye cream. This is my first time trying Mac skincare vs their makeup and I'm so happy with the quality. My sister tried some too and she's glowing

It comes in a gold glass bottle with a pump applicator, which is easy to use. I only applied one pump but it called for some more to evenly coat my face. This has hyaluronic acid, niacinamide, and salicylic acid. That helps with hydration, skin tone, and improves skin texture. Now my skin is softer after using for a week. I noticed my skin isn't dry like it used to. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

After two weeks of using the M·A·C Hyper Real Serumizer™ Eye 360° Bright Eye Treatment, I can confidently say this product has earned a spot in my daily routine. As someone who travels a lot, my under-eye area often shows signs of fatigue and dryness. Applying this gel-cream morning and night has been a game-changer. It absorbs quickly and provides an instant cooling, hydrating effect that feels refreshing after long flights or busy days. I don't wear makeup, but I appreciate how this product leaves my skin smooth and bright without any greasy residue. After consistent use, I've noticed my dark circles look lighter, and my under-eye area feels more firm and rejuvenated. The lightweight formula is perfect for travel—it's easy to pack and convenient to use on the go. I genuinely like this product and will absolutely purchase it before I run out. It's a must-have for anyone looking to maintain a fresh, well-rested look, no matter how hectic life gets. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: HYPER REAL SERUMIZER EYE 360 BRIGHT EYE TREATMENT IS AMAZING
avis.texte: I got to try the HYPER REAL Serumizer Eye 360 Bright Eye Treatment and it is amazing!!! I love the scent of it with the formula with Japanese Peony Extract, Vitamin C, Niacinamide and Peptide!!! It smells super good!!! I love how it is a nice texture and isn't sticky when the serum is on my finger tip or by my eye. I love how it helps with moisture, strengthens the skin barrier and can use while doing make up!!! I love how it easy it was to massage in my skin around my eyes and it feels super good!!! I love the fast absorbing and that its improvement in radiance, lightens and smooth crepiness along with uneven textures!!! My under eyes and brow bone feel smooth and I feel it really works!!! I would definitely recommend this to friends and family and all who want to try it!!! I really enjoy using it and it works, feels amazing and smells amazing as well!!! I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I love that it comes in a brush and apply format so that it's easy to focus application. The vitamin C niacinamide combo is also great to help those puffy under eyes and dark circles. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I really like this eye serum. First off the packaging is super nice. It's really high quality and I love the pump top. The serum itself is like a light lotion texture. It goes on very smooth and is hydrating. It doesn't leave any sort of sticky or greasy residue after application and doesn't soak in too fast which I like. One of the biggest things that I like about it is that it has no fragrance at all (fragrance can be bad for skin so I'm glad it's fragrance free) and it doesn't bother my skin. I have skin that can be pretty sensitive. I never get rashes or break outs from products but it's not unusual for skincare to sting or burn a bit on my skin after application for a while, especially if my pores are open after a shower. This does not burn or sting my skin at all hallelujah! I've been usuing it every night for around 2 months now. I can't say I've seen a huge difference in under eye discoloration, but I believe mine to be from thin skin and veins as opposed to hyperpigmentation which I think this is more suited to tackle. I think it has really helped with hydrating my under eye area though as I have less dry skin there now so I really like it and plan on continuing to use it. Good job Mac! These are my fully honest opinions but as a Note: I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

It has this beautiful, hydrating yet non-greasy finish that made my under eyes feel instantly plump and refreshed. There's a subtle radiance—nothing overly dewy, just that "healthy skin" look. I received this product for free from topbox

The MAC Hyper Real Serumizer Eye 360 Bright Eye Treatment has done wonders for my under eyes. I uses the serum morning and night for 7 days and noticed a difference in the dark circles. The serum also helped with my thin under eye skin making it look more plump and hydrated. It has a slight smell which I loved, not overwhelming or irritating. I will continue to use this serum in my routine. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for review and testing purposes.

avis.titre: Too much rubbing and not good for oily skin
avis.texte: I have mixed feelings about this eye treatment. It is moisturizing without being heavy, but it says to apply it all around your eye. As the day wears on and my skin naturally produces oil (particularly my eyelids), the oil moves any product that didn't fully absorb right into my eyes and causes irritation. If I only apply under my eyes, this isn't such an issue, but it kind of defeats the purpose of brightening all around the eye. I'm also really uncomfortable with how much rubbing (not just light dabbing) that it says to do to apply the product all around your eye. The skin around your eyes is so thin and sensitive, you need more product to not drag the skin as you rub, but then that's more product that just ends up melting into my eyes later in the day. Overall this is a pass for me. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

Being a mom to an 8 year old has given me noticeably dark circles around my eyes. I've been desperately searching for a brightening serum and I thankfully found in MAC. The Hyper Real Serum has an enjoyable, delicate scent and 1 pump gives plenty of product. It works nicely into the skin and you can instantly feel the tingling of the caffeine. I have been using it twice daily for a few weeks now and love the results and can feel a difference. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

This eye cream is ok. I have sensitive eyes where products tend to make my eyes sting and I did experience this slightly with this product. It does work though, I feel like my under eye was hydrating and bright when using this but I don't believe it made my concealer for my under eye look any different ( I was hoping it would be more hydrated) but I saw so difference. I tried to use this eye cream during the day and night to see if that made a difference and I didn't notice that it did but, I do think it works best using during the day and night instead one or another. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I was using this for a couple of weeks and noticed how soft the skin of my under eyes was. I like the consistency and texture of the product, it glided on very nicely. I didn't notice too much of a difference with my dark circles. I think it's a great way to moisturize your skin. I would recommend. Overall, very happy with this product. I probably would not purchase again, just because I feel like there are others that could also do the job. It's still great to use though. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I have been using this serumizer for a month. I apply it morning and night. I like that it is not greasy, does not irritate my eyes and is hydrating. Since I have used it for only a month, I have not seen any brightening, reduction in lines and dark circles. I will continue to use it to see if I get these results. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

This serum brighten and moisturizes the eye area, it works so well and it definitely shows, after apply my skin looks brighter and just all around better looking, it's breathable and doesn't feel heavy at all. received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I had received this product for free to try and as always I will give an honest review. I used this eye cream at night with a pump each for each eye. The formula is slightly cooling and has moisturized my under eyes well. It is not greasy and has a very light scent. Packaging is classy, clean and pump dispenses the perfect amount for one use. My complaint is that this product did not brighten my under eyes, I also looked at the ingredients and there was no particular active that would reduce dark circles which is why I cannot give the product more that 3 stars. If we're only judging by the moisturizing aspect than I would have rated it 4 starts. Overall it is a great eye cream but do not expect brightening properties. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Lightweight. Great for all around the eyes
avis.texte: The best part of this serum is that it's lightweight, which means that it tackles not only under eyes, but all around the eyes. For heavier cream products, I can never apply on my eyelids, as it causes acne or other skin issues. This is light enough to wear all around, although you may want to top up with some heavier cream under eyes. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.
I really enjoy using this eye cream. It is lightweight but moisturizing. Makes my under eyes feel soft.

I absolutely love this product, it feels luxurious. I like that it comes in a neat little bottle with a pump. This is smooth and creamy texture that absorbs nicely. avis.titre: Works Amazing, I can see results

avis.titre: Light & Hydrating but Not Effective for Brightening
avis.texte: I did enjoy using this product for over a month now, but I don't think it is very effective at brightening the under eyes and is overpriced. It has a very light and hydrating texture, which makes it absorb easily & feel light/not greasy. The skin around my eyes feels hydrated and this does help lessen the appearance of the finer wrinkles. But I didn't see any change in the color/brightness of my eye bags. I asked my family and they didn't notice any either other than my under eyes having less wrinkles or being slightly smoother. The packaging is also quite large and unnecessary for such a small amount of product. Overall, I think this product is very underwhelming for the price. There are other products are much more effective for less. I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.

I love how cute the bottle is and the lid is easy to get on and off. I like how smooth and creamy this feels and is lightweight, it isn't too heavy or thick but not too runny either. I noticed it moisturized and brightened so gave off a glow but didn't notice any difference with my dark circles or lines much over the past couple of weeks and I have tired eyes so I feel I would notice a difference but overall the consistency and how well it goes on and looks and feels when applying is nice so have hopes over more time that it might show to be more effective. My skin feels softer yet looks firmer. I appreciate that it doesn't have any added fragrance. I'm excited to continue using this and so far, in my opinion, it is a good option for anyone looking for an eye treatment. *" I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes."*

I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes. This serum was awesome! It works so good and makes my undereyes look smooth and feel great! Can't wait to keep using it!

I received this product for free from Topbox Marketing for testing and review purposes.
